about: SC-1 discovery questions -> the screener spec the Agent's planner should write, in the screener's own criteria language (parsed by the deterministic /grammar/parse path: grammar.compile_text + logic.validate). Scored deterministically, never with a model. `category` groups the score; `nl` marks phrasing that tests natural-language interpretation (synonyms, slang, units), the evidence for whether a paid compiler is ever needed. A refusal question expects SC-1 to refuse (indicator conditions are out of scope until IC-1 / SC-1 v1.2).
